description: Watch state for Lawrence Noble 1990 Killian Industries bronze Yoda statue (limited edition of 50, ~8-11in, made for Empire Strikes Back 10th anniversary). Excludes the unrelated 31-inch life-size Yoda statue.
notes: 2026-10-30 check: searched eBay (active+sold), Heritage Auctions (ha.com), and Propstore (propstoreauction.com / propstore.com) via web search. No eBay or Heritage listings found for the 1990 Killian Industries edition-of-50 small bronze. Propstore's William Plumb Collection lots #411 ('Lawrence Noble Original Small-Scale Bronze Yoda Statue') and #450 ('Limited-Edition Lawrence Noble Bronze Yoda Statue Artist Proof', AP 3/6) are from a 2023 auction and are excluded: #450 is an artist proof (1 of 6 made, not the 50-piece Killian consumer edition) and #411 appears to be Noble's original master sculpture, not a Killian-produced numbered piece. Also noted (but not tracked, outside eBay/Heritage/Propstore scope): an Etsy listing for a genuine numbered example (15/50), asking price ~$16,908 OBO — https://www.etsy.com/listing/776488721/the-empire-strikes-back-10th-anniversary
